text: Now concerning the coming of our Lord {Kyriou} Jesus (YHWH saves) Christ (the Anointed One) and our being gathered together to Him, we ask you⁺, brothers (and sisters),
not to be easily disconcerted or alarmed by any spirit {pneumatos} or message or letter {epistolēs} seeming to be from us, alleging that the Day of the Lord {Kyriou} has already come.
Let no one deceive you⁺ in any way, for it will not come until the rebellion occurs and the man of lawlessness (iniquity)—the son of destruction (ruin)—is revealed (uncovered).
He will oppose and exalt himself above every so-called god {Theon} or object of worship. So he will seat himself in the temple of God {Theou}, proclaiming himself to be God {Theos}.
Do you⁺ not remember that I told you⁺ these things while I was still with you⁺?
And you⁺ know what is now restraining him, so that he may be revealed (uncovered) at the proper time.
For the mystery of lawlessness (iniquity) is already at work, but the one who now restrains it will continue until he is taken out of the way.
And then the lawless one will be revealed (uncovered), whom the Lord {Kyrios} Jesus (YHWH saves) will slay with the breath {pneumati} of His mouth and annihilate by the majesty of His arrival.
The coming of the lawless one will be accompanied by the working of Satan (the adversary), with every kind of power {dynamei}, sign, and false wonder,
and with every wicked deception directed against those who are perishing, because they refused the love {agapēn} of the truth that would have saved them.
For this reason God {Theos} will send them a powerful delusion so that they believe the lie,
in order that judgment may come upon all who have disbelieved the truth and delighted in wickedness (unrighteousness).

But we should always thank God {Theō} for you⁺, brothers (and sisters) who are loved {ēgapēmenoi} by the Lord {Kyriou}, because God {Theos} chose you⁺ from the beginning (God has chosen you as the firstfruits) to be saved by the sanctification of the Spirit {Pneumatos} and by faith in the truth.
To this He called you⁺ through our gospel (good news), so that you may share in the glory {doxēs} of our Lord {Kyriou} Jesus (YHWH saves) Christ (the Anointed One).
Therefore, brothers (and sisters), stand firm and cling to the traditions we taught you⁺, whether by speech or by letter {epistolēs}.
Now may our Lord {Kyrios} Jesus (YHWH saves) Christ (the Anointed One) Himself and God {Theos} our Father {Patēr}, who by grace has loved {agapēsas} us and given us eternal comfort and good hope,
encourage your⁺ hearts and strengthen you in every good word and deed.
